segments.sn35.19:1.1: “Yo, bhikkhave, cakkhuṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:1.2: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.19:1.3: Yo sotaṃ … pe … yo ghānaṃ … pe … yo jivhaṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:1.6: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.19:1.7: Yo kāyaṃ … pe … yo manaṃ abhinandati, dukkhaṃ so abhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:1.9: Yo dukkhaṃ abhinandati, aparimutto so dukkhasmā”ti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.19:2.1: “Yo ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:2.2: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.19:2.3: Yo sotaṃ … pe … yo ghānaṃ … pe … yo jivhaṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:2.6: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi.
segments.sn35.19:2.7: Yo kāyaṃ … pe … yo manaṃ nābhinandati, dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati.
segments.sn35.19:2.9: Yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati, parimutto so dukkhasmā”ti vadāmi.

lines: Anupubbakathā pana nesaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayeneva veditabbāti.
19-22. Vaṭṭavivaṭṭameva kathitaṃ abhinandanānaṃ uppādanirodhānañca vasena desanāya pavattattā.
